title: 第13章 飞速进步第14章 呼吸法
content_zh:
时间飞逝。
距离新兵营的第一次十日考核，仅剩三天。
这五日，对第十七号浮陆上的数万新兵而言，是一场毫无喘息之机的炼狱。
独眼教官撕下了常规体能训练的伪装，将真正的星际军方高压淬体法搬上了台面。
【重力室】、【电击巷】、【傀儡战】。
每道训练各设有得分点，达标者将有积分奖励。
五天下来，医疗区的床位彻底爆满。
甚至有近千人因为根基受损或精神崩溃，主动按下了弃权按钮，被剥夺军籍，提前送往了暗无天日的矿星。
整个新兵营上空，弥漫着浓重的血腥味与绝望感。
但在这令人窒息的淘汰率中，江岳活了下来。
高压训练下带来的不仅是疲惫与精神问题，肉身的提升也是实打实的。
清晨五点，营房准时亮灯。
李泰像一具僵尸般从胶囊舱里爬出。
他整个人已经瘦了一大圈，眼窝深陷，布满血丝。
若不是每天靠着舒筋喷雾吊命，他早就在重力室里废了。
他转过僵硬的脖颈，看向旁边。
江岳正平静地穿上灰色的作训服。
双目清明，呼吸绵长。
动作之间，关节没有发出任何滞涩的异响。
“你这家伙……”

李泰的声音透着一股深深的无力与麻木，“到底是不是披着人皮的机械改造人？”
这五天，李泰亲眼看着江岳在重力室里蹲到双腿溢血，在电击巷里被电得浑身焦黑，在傀儡战中被铁皮傀儡按在地上捶。
可每天早上醒来，江岳身上的暗伤便会奇迹般地结痂消退。
那一身原本干瘪单薄的皮肉，就像是充了气一般，正在以肉眼可见的速度变得厚实坚韧。
李泰不懂。
他看不到江岳在深夜里，【安神】词条是如何强制大脑切断痛觉，用区区四个小时的深度睡眠，完成常人十几个小时都无法达到的细胞重组。
他也看不到，江岳在白天的魔鬼训练中，【韧皮】词条是如何一次次卸去外界的重压。
原本脆弱的表皮角质层已经脱落，取而代之的，是一层极薄、却致密如压实橡胶般的暗青色筋膜。
这五天里，江岳并未在任何一项训练中拔得头筹。
他未曾争得第一，但总能熬到及格线后两批才倒下。
这种“打不死、耗不垮”的表现，自然落入了教官的眼中。
content_en:
Time flies.
There are only three days left before the first ten-day assessment in the recruit camp.
These five days were a purgatory without any respite for the tens of thousands of recruits on Floating Land No. 17.
The one-eyed instructor tore off the pretense of regular physical training and brought the real interstellar military's high-pressure body tempering method to the table.
[Gravity Room], [Electric Shock Alley], [Puppet Battle].
Each training course has points, and those who meet the standards will be rewarded with points.
After five days, the beds in the medical area were completely full.
Nearly a thousand people even took the initiative to press the abstention button due to damage to their foundation or mental breakdown, were deprived of their military status, and were sent to the dark mining star in advance.
The sky above the entire recruit camp was filled with a strong smell of blood and a sense of despair.
But amidst this suffocating elimination rate, Jiang Yue survived.
High-pressure training not only brings fatigue and mental problems, but also physical improvements.
At five o'clock in the morning, the lights in the barracks were turned on on time.
Li Tai climbed out of the capsule like a zombie.
He had lost a lot of weight, and his eye sockets were sunken and bloodshot.
If he hadn't been relying on muscle-relaxing spray every day, he would have died in the gravity chamber.
He turned his stiff neck and looked to the side.
Jiang Yuezheng calmly put on his gray training uniform.
My eyes are clear and my breathing is long.
During the movement, the joints did not make any dull and abnormal sounds.
"You guy..."
Li Tai's voice revealed a deep sense of weakness and numbness, "Are you a mechanically modified person wearing human skin?"
In the past five days, Li Tai watched with his own eyes as Jiang Yue squatted in the gravity chamber until his legs bled, was electrocuted until his whole body was blackened in the electric shock alley, and was pinned to the ground and beaten by an iron puppet during the puppet battle.
But every morning when he wakes up, the hidden wounds on Jiang Yue's body will miraculously scab away.
The originally dry and thin skin seemed to be inflated, becoming thicker and tougher at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Li Tai doesn't understand.
He couldn't see how Jiang Yue, in the middle of the night, forced the brain to cut off the pain sensation with the [Soothing Mind] entry, and used only four hours of deep sleep to complete cell reorganization that ordinary people could not achieve in more than ten hours.
He also couldn't see how Jiang Yue relieved the pressure of the outside world time and time again during the devil's training during the day.
The originally fragile cuticle of the epidermis has fallen off and been replaced by an extremely thin layer of dark blue fascia that is as dense as compacted rubber.
In these five days, Jiang Yue did not come out on top in any training.
He never won the first place, but he always managed to survive two batches behind the passing line before falling.
This kind of performance of "cannot be beaten to death or exhausted" naturally fell into the eyes of the instructor.
